access.title: Access & restrictions
access.codeHint: Sellers must enter this code to register
access.codeRequiredError: Enter an access code. Without it nobody can register.
access.linkOnlyTitle: How “Only with link and access code” works
access.linkOnlyHidden: The bazaar does not appear in the search, on the start page or in search engines.
access.linkOnlyLink: Anyone with the link sees the bazaar page. You find the link in the settings once the bazaar exists, and pass it on yourself together with the code.

features.title: Features
features.intro: Decide what sellers and buyers can use at your bazaar. You can change this until the end of the bazaar.
features.discountsText: Sellers can lower their prices during the bazaar, for example towards the end of the day.
features.discountFromHint: Leave empty if discounts are allowed from the start.
features.offersText: During the bazaar, logged-in buyers suggest a price for accepted items. If the seller accepts, that price applies at the cash desk. Sellers decide per item whether they accept offers.
features.minimumText: Sellers set a minimum price per item that buyers do not see. At the cash desk the price may be negotiated down to it.
features.questionsText: Buyers ask public questions about an item and the seller answers. Everyone sees the answers, which avoids duplicate questions.
features.photosOptionalText: Sellers do not have to photograph every item – useful for many small items as at a children's bazaar. Items without photo show a placeholder.
features.maxItemsHint: Limits how many items a seller can register – so that intake and space are sufficient.
features.intakeFeeHint: Fixed fee for every accepted item, even if it does not sell – for example €3 per bike. It is deducted from the payout at settlement, in addition to the commission. Once the first seller has registered, you can only lower it.
features.labelsHint: Every label shows QR code, title and – if given – the size.
features.labelMarkUniversal: Universal label: the seller's lasting sorting mark
features.labelMarkUniversalHint: Helpers first sort by the large digit into ten piles, then by letters and number into the basket. The mark stays with the seller, so the labels also fit other bazaars with universal labels.
features.labelMarkNoneHint: Labels can be reused. To sort items back, the team has to scan every one.
features.priceOnLabel: Print the price on the label
features.priceOnLabelText: Helps at a cash desk without scanner. The printed price is fixed – so it is not printed when discounts are on.
features.priceOnLabelDiscounts: Discounts are switched on, so no price appears on the labels.
features.payOnSite: Payment still happens on site at the cash desk.
features.maxItemsLocked: Sellers registered with this limit: you can only raise it.
features.maxItemsLater: Once the first seller has registered, you can only raise it.
features.questionsDuringEventText: Items are visible beforehand, but questions can only be asked once the bazaar starts. Existing answers stay visible.
features.requiredFieldsText: Every item needs these details before it can be registered for the bazaar, e.g. the frame number as proof for the police. They only apply to categories that have the field. If something is missing, BazarPro asks the seller when registering the item.
features.requiredFieldsNone: The chosen categories have no extra fields.
features.privateSellersText: When registering, sellers confirm that they sell as private persons, not commercially.
features.fixedDataText: At the intake on site you check name and address against the ID card; if they differ, the seller corrects them in their profile first. From the first accepted item on they are fixed, and so are title, category, price and required details of every accepted item. This gives a reliable record of who offered what, e.g. for the police. Sellers need a complete profile for this.
features.discountFromNeedsDates: Choose the start and end of the bazaar first.
features.discountStartLater: You set when the discounts start under “When and where?”, once the date is fixed.
